title: Kehai rendered replay shot
description: <out>.json, written beside every shot render_shot.sh renders (ReplayRender.cs): what was rendered, for the editor. Times are seconds into the shift.

stem.description: The shift's stem, e.g. shift_03_20260930_101500 (its .markers.json and report share it).

moment.description: The clip moment's rank in <stem>.markers.json, or null when -from/-to were given.

shot.description: pov, cctv, chase, orbit, topdown, path, or the camera path file.

layers.description: Karen's mind drawn in: empty for the store alone.

alpha.description: Her mind alone on a transparent background (for picture-in-picture).

video.description: The video's file name beside this file, or frame_%06d.png for a folder of frames.

audio.description: The WAV mixed at the camera (also muxed into the video); null for an alpha render.

track.description: Where Karen and you are in the picture (ShotTrack.cs), `hz` times a second from the first frame: [x, y, r] is the body's middle (0..1 from the top left) and half its width as a fraction of the frame's width; null when the body is off screen or not there. Shots rendered before Phase 6 have none.
